digest.headline: The Nasdaq dropped as chipmakers sold off and US price data approached.

lede.b: The Nasdaq stock market fell because companies that make computer memory chips suffered a sharp sell-off. A stock market index is a group of shares tracked together to measure how a part of the market is doing, like an average score for a team. When investors buy fewer shares and sell more, prices drop. This happens when traders adjust their positions before new government data about price increases comes out.
lede.i: The Nasdaq composite index closed lower as memory chipmakers suffered a heavy sell-off during the session. Equities faced selling pressure as market participants adjusted positions ahead of upcoming US consumer price index figures. The broader S&P 500 finished the trading day flat while bank earnings rolled in.
lede.a: The Nasdaq composite retreated following a sharp correction in memory chipmaker equities. Portfolio managers rebalanced risk exposures ahead of the anticipated US consumer price index print, while the S&P 500 managed a flat close. Trading desks simultaneously digested incoming commercial bank earnings reports.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: Indices move as chipmakers fall and US inflation data nears

stories.t: Nasdaq Drops as Chipmakers Sell Off
stories.b: The Nasdaq stock index fell after memory chipmakers saw heavy selling. An index is a basket of different company shares grouped together to track a market. Shares represent small pieces of ownership in a company. Companies like ARM and QCOM were in focus during the session. The S&P 500 index ended flat on the day.
stories.i: The Nasdaq closed lower as memory chipmakers suffered a sharp sell-off. Market participants focused on equities including BAC, GME, SPCX, ARM, and QCOM during the downturn. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 managed to finish the session completely flat. Bank earnings also rolled in as trading progressed.
stories.a: The Nasdaq retreated due to heavy liquidation across memory chipmakers, dragging down related large-cap names. Equities such as BAC, GME, SPCX, ARM, and QCOM experienced heightened volume and price pressure. Conversely, the S&P 500 proved resilient, neutralizing sector-specific losses to close unchanged. This divergence occurred alongside ongoing bank earnings releases.

stories.t: Gold Holds Steady Ahead of US Price Data
stories.b: Gold prices remained steady while traders waited for upcoming US inflation figures. Inflation measures how fast the general price level for goods and services rises over time. This upcoming economic data point affects currency values globally. The dollar-yen exchange rate held in the lower 158 range prior to the release.
stories.i: Gold prices maintained their ground as markets braced for United States inflation data. Currency traders kept the dollar-yen pairing steady in the lower 158 range ahead of the consumer price index. An upside surprise in the upcoming release could push the exchange rate toward 159.
stories.a: Spot gold consolidated its range as macro accounts squared positions ahead of the United States inflation print. The dollar-yen pair remained anchored in the lower 158 band, reflecting market hesitancy before the CPI release. Implied volatility suggests an upside surprise could trigger a momentum push toward 159.

politics.b: Federal Reserve officials discussed the state of the economy and the banking sector in Boston.
politics.i: Representatives from the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston delivered perspectives on economic conditions and the banking landscape.
politics.a: Officials at the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston published evaluations concerning macroeconomic conditions and the banking sector landscape.

United Kingdom.label: United Kingdom
United Kingdom.sub: FTSE 100 falls and Bank of England comments on costs

stories.t: FTSE 100 drops on geopolitical tensions
stories.b: The FTSE 100 is a major stock market index, which tracks the shares of the one hundred biggest companies listed in London. The FTSE 100 fell to 10,650.34 points. The drop happened during ongoing tensions between Ukraine and Russia. The index tracks how valuable these large businesses are in total.
stories.i: The FTSE 100 declined to 10,650.34. Market participants reacted to ongoing Ukraine-Russia tensions. Equities traded lower across the benchmark index during the session. Selling pressure pushed the index down to 10,650.34.
stories.a: The FTSE 100 retreated to 10,650.34. Geopolitical risk premia tied to Ukraine-Russia tensions drove the downside move in large-cap equities. Macro volatility compressed valuations across the headline index. The index closed lower at 10,650.34 as risk aversion dominated order flow.

stories.t: Bank of England Governor notes corporate cost focus
stories.b: Andrew Bailey is the Governor of the Bank of England, which is the central bank for the UK that sets monetary policy and interest rates. He stated that companies are focusing heavily on costs. Businesses are watching their expenses closely now. This corporate behavior reflects the current economic environment.
stories.i: Bank of England Governor Bailey reported that companies are sharpening their focus on expenses. Corporate entities are prioritizing cost management in the current operating environment. Central bank officials monitor these operational adjustments closely. Businesses continue to navigate margin pressures through strict expense controls.
stories.a: Bank of England Governor Bailey highlighted a persistent corporate focus on cost containment. Firms are prioritizing operational efficiency to protect margins against macro headwinds. Monetary policymakers track these microeconomic adjustments for signals on pricing power and wage demands. Corporate balance sheet defense remains the dominant strategic theme.

politics.b: Officials in Jefferson County are still looking for answers five years after a local man went missing.
politics.i: Authorities in Jefferson County continue their search for information five years after the disappearance of a local man.
politics.a: Jefferson County officials maintain an active investigation into a missing person case originating 5 years prior.

Germany.label: Germany
Germany.sub: German inflation accelerates while DAX index dips slightly

stories.t: German Equities Close Lower as Infineon Declines
stories.b: The DAX index is a group of major company shares traded on the German stock market. This index finished the trading session down 0.1% or 0.10%. Stock prices move up and down based on company performance and wider economic news. Infineon is a specific company whose share price slid during this session, contributing to the overall market drop.
stories.i: The inflation backdrop weighed on sentiment as the DAX index closed 0.1% lower. Equities drifted downward following a slide in shares of Infineon. Market participants monitored macroeconomic data prints while regional yields drifted alongside US equivalents.
stories.a: German equities closed marginally lower with the DAX down 0.10% following a notable slide in Infineon shares. Eurozone sovereign yields compressed in tandem with US Treasuries as desks positioned ahead of upcoming macroeconomic prints. Price action reflects subdued risk appetite amid incoming cost-of-living metrics.

stories.t: German Price Growth Accelerates and Tests Rate Expectations
stories.b: Inflation is the speed at which prices for goods and services go up over time. German price growth reignited and accelerated during the session. This price acceleration tests the nerves of market participants who track interest rates set by central banks.
stories.i: German inflation reignited and accelerated across the economy. This renewed price pressure tested the market's rate nerves regarding future monetary policy adjustments. Eurozone yields declined overall even as local price metrics ticked higher.
stories.a: German inflation prints accelerated, directly challenging current rate expectations. The renewed upward trajectory in domestic price metrics tests market positioning across European debt curves. Sovereign yield curves flattened despite the local inflationary impulse.

politics.b: No political updates are listed in the current market sources.
politics.i: No political updates are listed in the current market sources.
politics.a: No political updates are listed in the current market sources.

timeline: The DAX index closed 0.1% lower after Infineon shares slid.
German inflation accelerated, testing market rate expectations.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Nikkei bounces and yen holds as traders watch inflation

stories.t: Nikkei bounces after semiconductor shares recover
stories.b: The Nikkei index went up after four days of falling. An index is a group of company shares tracked together to show how a market is doing. Semiconductor stocks led the bounce. Bargain-hunting investors bought these shares because their prices had dropped.
stories.i: The Nikkei index advanced following a four-day slide. Semiconductor shares drove the rebound as investors engaged in bargain-hunting. Market participants adjusted positions ahead of upcoming US data.
stories.a: The Nikkei rebounded from a four-day downward correction. Semiconductor equities catalyzed the recovery via tactical bargain-hunting. Price action remains tied to broader regional sentiment as market participants await external macro prints.

stories.t: Dollar-yen rate holds in lower 158 range
stories.b: The Japanese yen stayed steady against the US dollar in the lower 158 range. Traders are waiting for US consumer price index data to come out. Reports also showed that the Bank of Japan might lean against raising interest rates.
stories.i: Dollar-yen held steady in the lower 158 range ahead of US CPI figures. Reports indicating that the Bank of Japan leans against an imminent rate hike weighed on the currency. The yen trailed major peers as market participants priced in policy divergence.
stories.a: USD-JPY consolidated in the lower 158 band ahead of the US consumer price index print. Reports suggesting the Bank of Japan leans against tightening restrained the currency. The spot rate trades near levels that previously triggered official scrutiny.

politics.b: NTT Data is in final talks to build Anthropic's first data center in Japan.
politics.i: NTT Data entered final talks to construct Anthropic's initial data center in Japan.
politics.a: NTT Data advanced to final negotiations for the construction of Anthropic's inaugural Japanese data center infrastructure.

China.label: China
China.sub: Tencent bond sale and CATL fund investments

stories.t: Tencent Issues Notes for Artificial Intelligence
stories.b: Tencent is a big technology company. It raised $1.8 billion and 26 billion yuan by selling debt. Debt is when a company borrows money from investors and promises to pay it back with interest. The company will use this cash for artificial intelligence work.
stories.i: Tencent raised $1.8 billion and 26 billion yuan through note sales under its MTN programme. These debt instruments help fund its artificial intelligence expansion. Corporate bond issuance allows major firms to tap global liquidity pools directly.
stories.a: Tencent priced $1.8 billion alongside 26 billion yuan in notes via its medium-term note programme to fund artificial intelligence infrastructure. This dual-currency issuance highlights how large cap tech issuers leverage cross-border yield differentials and deep liquidity pools. The duration and spread pricing on these notes imply strong institutional appetite for tech-sector credit risk despite macroeconomic headwinds.

stories.t: CATL Backs New Energy Fund and DeepCtr
stories.b: CATL is a major energy company. It is putting 400 million yuan into a new energy investment fund. It also led a funding round for DeepCtr, which works on energy management for artificial intelligence data centres.
stories.i: CATL committed 400 million yuan to a new energy investment fund. It also led a Series B+ funding round securing hundreds of millions of yuan for DeepCtr. DeepCtr focuses on energy management solutions for artificial intelligence data centres.
stories.a: CATL deployed 400 million yuan into a new energy investment fund and led DeepCtr's Series B+ round to capture exposure in artificial intelligence data centre energy management. These equity allocations demonstrate vertical integration strategies into high-demand power infrastructure. The minority stakes reflect venture deployment patterns targeting grid efficiency and computational power constraints.

stories.t: Nantong Lianya Plans Shenzhen Share Sale
stories.b: Nantong Lianya is offering shares to the public. It will sell 133.7 million shares. Each share will cost 7 yuan. The sale will happen on the Shenzhen stock exchange.
stories.i: Nantong Lianya scheduled a public equity offering on the Shenzhen exchange. The firm will issue 133.7 million shares. Each share is priced at 7 yuan.
stories.a: Nantong Lianya priced its Shenzhen listing at 7 yuan per share to issue 133.7 million shares. Primary market valuations at this level test domestic retail and institutional demand for industrial listings. The capital raised will add to the company's balance sheet capacity.

politics.b: China's tracked baijiu basket dropped by 0.11% on October 13. This points to ongoing weakness in that market. Meanwhile, the Chinese yuan kept a mildly positive outlook against the US dollar.
politics.i: China's tracked baijiu basket declined 0.11% on October 13, pointing to persistent weakness in domestic consumption. Concurrently, the Chinese yuan maintained a mildly positive technical outlook against the US dollar.
politics.a: China's tracked baijiu basket dropped 0.11% on October 13, signaling ongoing consumer demand contraction in discretionary sectors. Simultaneously, the Chinese yuan retained a mildly positive trajectory against the US dollar across spot rate forecasts.

India.label: India
India.sub: IT stocks surge and Reserve Bank defends the rupee

stories.t: Nifty IT Records Largest Single-Day Advance in Seventeen Months
stories.b: The Nifty IT index jumped 5.2%. This is the biggest single-day gain for the index in 17 months. Stocks in the technology sector rose sharply. Share prices track the market value of companies. Investors bought up technology shares during the session.
stories.i: The Nifty IT index surged 5.2% to log its largest single-day advance in 17 months. Technology shares rallied across the board during the session. Market participants increased their exposure to the sector following positive broader sentiment. Trading volumes expanded as buyers pushed prices higher.
stories.a: The Nifty IT index printed a 5.2% gain, marking its most substantial single-day upward break in 17 months. Sectoral momentum accelerated as institutional participants reallocated capital into tech equities. Price action reflected concentrated buying pressure across major constituents. The advance outpaced broader market benchmarks during the session.

stories.t: Reserve Bank Deploys Measures and Auctions to Support the Rupee
stories.src: Moneycontrol.com · Bloomberg.com · The New Indian Express
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India announced an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction for 50,000 crore rupees. A reverse repo auction is when the central bank, which is the main bank for the country's financial system, borrows money from commercial banks to control cash levels. The rupee rose 49 paise after the governor spoke about curbs to halt speculation. However, analysts note these actions only patch long-term weakness.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction of 50,000 crore rupees to manage liquidity. The rupee climbed 49 paise following comments from the central bank governor regarding curbs on speculation. Market observers argue that these intervention measures offer temporary support rather than reversing the currency's fundamental decline. Domestic bonds simultaneously faced headwinds from currency defense and inflation pressures.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India announced a 50,000 crore rupee overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction to drain surplus liquidity from the banking system. The spot rupee appreciated 49 paise after the governor reiterated regulatory curbs intended to suppress speculative short positions. Analysts maintain that such liquidity management tools provide only superficial remediation for structural currency weakness. Sovereign debt instruments absorbed dual pressures from inflation prints and ongoing foreign exchange intervention costs.

stories.t: Sensex Jumps Following Finance Minister Remarks on Capital Gains Tax
stories.b: The Sensex index jumped 1,100 points. The increase happened after Finance Minister Sitharaman said the government will hear investors regarding the long-term capital gains tax. Capital gains tax is a levy on profits made from selling an investment like shares. Investors hope the government might cut this tax rate.
stories.i: The Sensex rallied 1,100 points after Finance Minister Sitharaman stated that the government will listen to investor concerns regarding the long-term capital gains tax. Market participants interpreted the remarks as a potential precursor to tax relief on investment profits. Trading sentiment strengthened significantly across domestic equities following the announcement. The policy commentary drove sharp buying activity in major stock indexes.
stories.a: The Sensex advanced 1,100 points following remarks from Finance Minister Sitharaman indicating openness to stakeholder representations on the long-term capital gains tax. Market participants repriced equity risk premiums on expectations of potential fiscal adjustments to capital gains levies. This policy signal catalyzed broad-based buying across the index, compressing discount rates applied to domestic valuations. Asset allocators responded by bidding up large-cap equities during the session.

politics.b: The government stated it will listen to investors about the long-term capital gains tax.
politics.i: Finance Minister Sitharaman indicated that the government will engage with investors regarding the long-term capital gains tax.
politics.a: Finance Minister Sitharaman signaled administrative receptivity to investor feedback regarding long-term capital gains taxation frameworks.

timeline: 13 Oct

Brazil.label: Brazil
Brazil.sub: Petrobras deals and rising inflation forecasts

stories.t: Petrobras Secures Equalization Deal and Subsidy Payments
stories.b: Petrobras secures 2.8 billion reais in payments linked to a gasoline and diesel subsidy. The energy company also secures US$859 million through a Santos Basin equalization agreement. Shell and TotalEnergies sign separate deals that deliver net payments to Petrobras. UBS raises its target for the stock of Petrobras to USD 23.00.
stories.i: Petrobras collects 2.8 billion reais related to a domestic fuel subsidy. The state-controlled producer also secures US$859 million via a Santos Basin equalization deal. Shell and TotalEnergies finalize agreements delivering net payments to Petrobras. UBS subsequently raises its target for Petrobras equity to USD 23.00.
stories.a: Petrobras absorbs 2.8 billion reais in fuel subsidy proceeds alongside a US$859 million Santos Basin equalization settlement. Corresponding net remittance agreements signed by Shell and TotalEnergies augment cash flow metrics. UBS responds to these operational developments by elevating its equity target for Petrobras to USD 23.00.

stories.t: Ibovespa Slips as Inflation Forecasts Rise
stories.b: The Ibovespa stock index drops because the forecast for inflation rises. Persistent price growth dampens enthusiasm for a lower Selic interest rate. The exchange rate for the US dollar and the British pound against the Brazilian real moves higher.
stories.i: The Ibovespa index declines as the inflation forecast climbs. Persistent price pressures temper market enthusiasm for a reduction in the Selic benchmark interest rate despite recent rallies. Concurrently, the US dollar and British pound appreciate against the Brazilian real.
stories.a: The Ibovespa retreats in response to an upward revision in inflation expectations. Sticky price dynamics undermine earlier conviction regarding Selic rate cuts. Meanwhile, cross-rate appreciation drives the US dollar and British pound higher against the Brazilian real.

politics.b: Government policies on fuel subsidies directly affect the finances of state-backed company Petrobras. Price pressures also influence central bank interest rate decisions. These economic factors shape public financial debates across the country.
politics.i: State fuel subsidy mechanisms dictate capital flows into Petrobras balance sheets. Meanwhile, persistent price pressures complicate monetary policy management by the central bank regarding the Selic rate. Fiscal and monetary levers remain central to domestic economic administration.
politics.a: State intervention via fuel subsidies dictates Petrobras cash flow realizations and equalization accounting. Concurrently, sticky price prints constrain the central bank's monetary easing cycle by keeping terminal Selic rate expectations elevated. These dynamics test the institutional coordination between fiscal policy and monetary authorities.

timeline: Petrobras receives 2.8 billion reais in subsidy payments and secures a US$859 million equalization deal.

Saudi Arabia.label: Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia.sub: Aramco headquarters struck by missile attacks

stories.t: Missile Strikes Saudi Aramco Headquarters
stories.b: A missile hit the main offices of Saudi Aramco, which is a giant state-owned oil company. The attack caused a fire to start at the building located in Dhahran. Houthis launched a wave of missiles toward the country. Four people were reported wounded in Riyadh due to the attacks.
stories.i: A fresh wave of missile attacks struck the administrative building of Saudi Aramco at its Dhahran headquarters. The strikes triggered a limited fire at the energy facility. Four people sustained injuries in Riyadh during the coordinated Houthi offensive.
stories.a: Houthi forces launched a missile barrage targeting Saudi Aramco's administrative headquarters in Dhahran, resulting in a localized fire at the energy complex. Concurrent strikes impacted Riyadh, leaving four individuals wounded. The latest escalation follows a Saudi-led coalition air strike on an oil site in Sanaa.

stories.t: Cross-Border Strikes Expose Energy Infrastructure
stories.b: A Saudi-led coalition hit an oil site in Sanaa hours before the missiles arrived. The Houthis fired missiles across the border into Saudi Arabia. The attack hit the energy giant Aramco directly at its headquarters.
stories.i: A Saudi-led coalition airstrike targeted an oil site in Sanaa ahead of the cross-border missile barrage. The Houthi movement responded with a fresh wave of projectiles aimed at Saudi infrastructure. The strikes breached security around Saudi Aramco in Dhahran.
stories.a: A Saudi-led coalition strike on a Sanaa oil facility preceded the Houthi missile offensive. The ensuing barrage penetrated air defenses to hit Saudi Aramco's Dhahran administrative building. The exchange marks an escalation in hostilities between the regional adversaries.

politics.b: The Saudi-led coalition carried out an air strike on an oil site in Sanaa. Houthi forces responded by firing a wave of missiles into Saudi Arabia. The strikes hit government and energy locations in Riyadh and Dhahran.
politics.i: A Saudi-led coalition attack struck an oil facility in Sanaa. The Houthi faction retaliated with a missile offensive targeting locations in Riyadh and Dhahran. The exchanges highlight the ongoing military conflict between the regional forces.
politics.a: A coalition led by Saudi Arabia struck an oil installation in Sanaa, prompting a retaliatory Houthi missile campaign. The strikes targeted critical infrastructure in Riyadh and the Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran. Both sides intensified kinetic operations across the border.

timeline: 13 Oct

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: Naira movements, oil quotas, and reserves

stories.t: Naira softens against the dollar
stories.b: The Nigerian naira is the official money used in Nigeria. It lost value compared to the US dollar for the second day in a row. The exchange rate moved to N1,332.99 per dollar at the NAFEM window, which is a marketplace where currencies are traded. Foreign exchange reserves reached $55bn.
stories.i: The naira recorded a second day of depreciation against the USD. The official exchange rate shifted to N1,332.99 per dollar at the NAFEM window from a previous rate of N1,331. Foreign exchange reserves reached $55bn during this period.
stories.a: The naira depreciated for a second consecutive session against the USD, settling at N1,332.99 per dollar at NAFEM. Concurrently, foreign exchange reserves registered at $55bn while short-term buyers drove the euro higher against the naira from oversold levels.

stories.t: Crude quota met and inflation outlook
stories.b: Nigeria met its OPEC crude oil quota for the fifth straight month in September. Oil prices are at $100. Analysts expect inflation, which means when things cost more over time, to hit 15.5%.
stories.i: Nigeria met its OPEC crude quota for the fifth consecutive month in September amid a $100 oil price environment. Businessday reports that inflation is projected at 15.5% as these commodity dynamics cloud the macroeconomic outlook.
stories.a: Nigeria sustained its OPEC crude quota compliance for the fifth consecutive month through September against a backdrop of $100 oil prices. Meanwhile, consensus expectations project headline inflation at 15.5%, introducing headwinds to the domestic monetary transmission mechanism.

politics.b: President Tinubu asked the Senate to approve returning 100 billion naira to the Yobe government for building an airport. Former military leader Buratai denied military involvement in a 2018 arms deal worth one billion naira.
politics.i: President Tinubu requested Senate approval to reimburse the Yobe state government 100 billion naira for constructing an airport. Concurrently, Buratai denied military involvement in a 2018 arms procurement deal valued at one billion naira.
politics.a: President Tinubu submitted a formal request to the Senate seeking approval to reimburse the Yobe state government 100 billion naira for airport construction expenditures. Separately, Buratai formally disputed military involvement in the 2018 one billion naira arms procurement controversy.

timeline: A one billion naira arms deal occurred, which Buratai denied military involvement in.

Australia.label: Australia
Australia.sub: Glencore ASX debut and Overwatch listing update

stories.t: Glencore Rises on ASX Debut
stories.b: Glencore is a large global company that digs up and sells natural resources. It started trading its shares on the Australian Securities Exchange, which is the main market where company ownership slices are bought and sold. Its share price went up during this first day of trading. The event marked a new chapter for the company on the exchange.
stories.i: Glencore recorded a share price increase during its debut on the Australian Securities Exchange. The listing brought the major resource company onto the domestic board. Trading activity commenced with positive momentum for the incoming stock. The initial session closed with the equity higher than its reference point.
stories.a: Glencore advanced on its initial public offering session on the Australian Securities Exchange. The cross-border dual listing incorporated heavy institutional participation during the opening auction. Order book depth supported the early upward drift in valuation. Subsequent liquidity metrics will determine index inclusion weighting.

stories.t: Overwatch Technologies Secures ASX Admission
stories.b: Overwatch Technologies is a business that successfully raised £8 million in funding. The company finished its paperwork to join the Australian stock market. Its shares will officially begin trading on 16 October 2026. Investors put money into the firm before it started trading publicly.
stories.i: Overwatch Technologies completed an £8 million capital raise ahead of its official admission to the Australian Securities Exchange. The company lodged its listing information form to clear the administrative hurdles for entry. Trading in the equity is scheduled to commence on 16 October 2026. The initial public offering provides capital for upcoming operational milestones.
stories.a: Overwatch Technologies secured admission to the Australian Securities Exchange following an £8 million primary issuance. The entity finalized its listing information documentation to satisfy regulatory requirements. Market participants will initiate trading in the security on 16 October 2026. The capitalization provides runway for the firm's strategic objectives.

politics.b: Government leaders did not announce any new tax laws or spending plans for the stock market today. Market rules and company listings are handled by independent regulators. Politicians focused on other matters instead of business share listings.
politics.i: State and federal authorities remained uninvolved in the corporate listings and capital raises. Regulatory oversight of the exchange stays with statutory bodies rather than elected officials. Fiscal policy statements stayed absent from the daily market flow.
politics.a: Executive branches maintained strict separation from the primary market issuances and exchange admissions. Statutory oversight of the listing mechanics remains delegated to independent market authorities. No legislative interventions impacted the capitalization schedules.

timeline: Glencore records share price gains during its debut session on the Australian Securities Exchange.
Overwatch Technologies lodges its listing information form after completing an £8 million capital raise.
Overwatch Technologies is scheduled to commence official trading on the Australian Securities Exchange.
